title: The Journal
summary: The JOURNAL from Rockwell Automation and Our PartnerNetwork™ is a bimonthly magazine, published by Putman Media, Inc., designed to educate engineers about leading-edge industrial automation methods, trends and technologies.
body_markdown:
Award-winning The Journal from Rockwell Automation and Our PartnerNetwork™ publishes 4 print and 8 digital magazines annually to educate plant managers, operations staff, engineers, manufacturing equipment operators, maintenance staff, software programmers, system integrators, OEMs and other industrial automation professionals about leading-edge methods, trends and technologies. Our goal is to help you keep production lines running cost-effectively and safely while producing quality products. The magazine is published by Endeavor Business Media for Rockwell Automation.
